been with this surgery since I was small, and there have been many instances where they have let me down. Here are some examples:

I made a few appointments in the past regarding my mental health and I never really felt listened too, I think due to my young age they didn’t take me seriously, and I felt that the doctor somewhat hinted that it was a “phase” and that I would grow out of it, I was told to do things like yoga.
In my last appointment regarding my mental health, I was told that the doctor would refer me to something that would help (it was something like a group/place, can’t remember too well), but nothing ever came of that.

I was once misdiagnosed. I had severe abdominal pain, I couldn’t keep anything down and I couldn’t sleep, this was brushed off as a stomach bug but after enduring this “stomach bug” for a few more days I made another appointment with the GP and luckily it was with a different doctor, after examining me the doctor told me I needed to go to the hospital immediately, not long after arriving at the hospital I had to have surgery and I eventually found out that the cause of my pain etc, was that my intestines were twisted around themselves.

As a woman, I feel many of my issues aren’t being listened to. I struggle with endometriosis and was often just told to go on the pill, even after stating I did not want to go on the pill for a few reasons. I was never told about alternatives (implant, IUD, etc.)
The doctors who I would see about my endometriosis made it seem like what I was going through was normal, when I knew it wasn’t, I knew from age 11 I had endometriosis but it took until I was around 19 to be referred to gynaecology for help, and I was only referred because I finally didn’t take no for an answer and non-stop badgered them. The doctor was so rude about referring me, as if it affected them.

The receptionists have bad customer service skills, and the doctors don’t care about patients.
